Who: IADA Irrigation Engineers & Water User Groups (KPA)
Window: Active tillering (35–40 HST) to harvest drainage (85–95 HST)
What: Maintain 5–10 cm water depth during Active Tillering (35–40 HST) and Panicle Initiation (50–60 HST); drain completely 10–14 days pre-harvest (85–95 HST).
Source: DOA Manual Tanaman Padi (Days 35–95), Kaedah Pengurusan Tanaman Padi (Water Section), & MYSA MakGeoPadi Schedule

Who: DOA / IADA Extension Agronomists & PPK Officers
What: Check Leaf Colour Chart (LCC < 3 direct seeding) and broadcast split subsidized fertilizers: Compound 17.5:15.5:10 (250 kg/ha at 15–20 HST), Urea 46% N + MOP (35–40 HST), and Baja Sebatian 12:12:17:2 (50–70 HST, +5 days in wet season).
Source: IADA Pulau Pinang Paddy Management Manual & DOA Kaedah Pengurusan Tanaman Padi (Fertilising Section)

Window: Weekly scouting; blast check at 10% heading
What: Scout weekly for brown planthopper (> 20 adults/m²), pianggang (> 2 adults/m² at milk stage), and blast at 10% heading; hold field water 21–28 days post-spraying.
Source: DOA Kaedah Pengurusan Tanaman Padi (Pest & Disease Control) & FAO Irrigation Paper (Section 4.4)
